title: {p} and {v} Gumbo
steps: Cook the {s} following the package directions and keep it warm.
In a large pot, soften the {v} in oil for about 5 minutes, then stir in the {spice} for a minute.
Add the {sauce} and 3 cups of broth. Simmer, covered, for about 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Add the {p} and cook until {doneness}. Serve over the {s}.
tip: Okra thickens the gumbo, so you can skip the heavy roux and keep it lighter.
